Definition: a pit (for wild animals) (as cut out)
BiblicalUsage: gôb means a pit, a den for wild animals. In Daniel 6:7, the text says "he shall be cast into the den of lions." In Daniel 6:12, the text says "shall be cast into the den of lions? The king answered and said."
TheologicalSignificance: For me, gôb is a reminder that God really does deliver; escape is not luck, it is His hand at work. That shapes how I read the passages where it appears: not as filler, but as God's own wording for what He is doing.
